title: Task 2.1: Benefits and Challenges of Learning a New Language
content:
Read the following statement:

"Learning a foreign language enables people to communicate effectively and opens up great opportunities for employment, travel, and international education. However, language learners often encounter significant challenges, such as a lack of time, difficulty in memorizing new vocabulary, and grammatical complexity."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and challenges of learning a new language. Provide specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or experience to support your perspective.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was stuck in a low-paying local job because he could not speak English well. Therefore, he decided to practice speaking daily with AI tools and attend an evening class. As a result, he finally got a promotion at an international company. If he had not learned English seriously, he would not have been able to improve his career.
body1.focus: Advantages of learning a new language (Career & Knowledge)
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, learning a new foreign language brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make learning a new foreign language appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that speaking a foreign language opens up better career opportunities and helps improve people's living standard. This means that workers who know English or another language can easily apply to international companies and earn a higher salary. Another point I would like to make is that learning a new language helps people broaden their mind. This is because of the fact that reading foreign books and talking to international friends give us a deeper understanding of other cultures and traditions.

body2.example: For example, I was struggling to remember twenty new English words every night after work last year. For this reason, I got to learn how to break my study into short fifteen-minute sessions every morning. If I had not changed my study habit, I would not have been able to know that steady daily practice works much better than cramming.
body2.focus: Challenges of learning a new language (Time, Vocabulary & Grammar)
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of learning a new foreign language are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that a lack of time and difficulty memorizing new vocabulary can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, learning a new language costs a great deal of money, time, and effort for busy students and workers. This happens because when people work full-time all day, it easily leads to feeling too tired to study regularly in the evening. In addition, memorizing hundreds of new words and complex grammar rules can make many beginners lose motivation and give up early.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, learning a new foreign language brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from opening up better job opportunities and broadening their mind, they also need to handle a lack of time and difficulty memorizing new vocabulary. Therefore, both individuals and schools should work together to make the most of learning a new foreign language responsibly.

content:
Read the following statement:

"In recent years, the rapid expansion of digital networks in Vietnam and across the globe has led to a dramatic surge in cybercrime, encompassing fraud schemes, phishing websites, and data theft, which causes profound financial losses and psychological distress to citizens and businesses."

Write an essay to an educated reader analyzing the harmful impacts of cybercrime and proposing practical solutions that individuals, tech corporations, and law enforcement agencies should adopt to curb this menace.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was looking for a cheap flight ticket online and clicked a fake website link sent to his phone. Therefore, he decided to enter his bank details without checking the website address carefully. As a result, he finally lost five million dong from his account before the bank could block it. If he had not clicked that strange link, he would not have been tricked by online scammers.
body1.focus: Serious negative effects of cybercrime on citizens and businesses
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, cybercrime and malicious websites lead to several serious negative effects | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these are the key impacts of cybercrime and malicious websites.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that sharing private details online or clicking strange links allows cyber criminals to steal bank accounts and personal identities easily. This means that ordinary citizens and small businesses can lose their savings in just a few minutes. Another point I would like to make is that falling victim to online scams causes heavy emotional stress. This is because of the fact that victims often feel worried, ashamed, and afraid to use helpful digital services afterward.

body2.example: For example, local banks now send clear warning messages about fake links while citizens attend community workshops to learn safe online banking habits, which helps reduce scam cases step by step.
body2.focus: Practical solutions for individuals, tech companies, and authorities
body2.frame: Mở: In order to resolve such problems, both individuals and organizations should take practical measures | Ruột Solutions (Cá nhân + Tổ chức + Education)
body2.point: One primary solution would be that individuals should stay on the safe side by using strong passwords, checking website links carefully, and never sharing private bank codes. In addition, tech companies and local authorities need to improve data security, block fake websites quickly, and apply fair rules to stop online scammers. Above all, education plays a key role in tackling this issue, because people need to be aware of its impacts so that they can act responsibly.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, cybercrime and malicious websites are closely linked to serious financial losses and mental stress and require practical steps such as stronger online safety habits, better tech security, and public education. Therefore, both citizens and local authorities need to take steady, practical actions to reduce cybercrime in the long run.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was staying up past midnight every day to watch videos and play online games. Therefore, he decided to skip morning exercise and rarely joined family dinners. Another point I would like to make is that careless internet habits put personal privacy in danger. This is because of the fact that sharing private details online or clicking strange links allows cyber criminals to steal personal accounts easily.

body2.example: For example, many families now keep phones away from the dinner table while local schools organize digital safety workshops and sports clubs, helping young people build a healthier daily balance.

Above all, education plays a key role in tackling this issue, because people need to be aware of its impacts so that they can act responsibly.

title: Task 1.34: Formal Email Replying to a Parent About a School Field Trip
content:
You are a school teacher organizing an upcoming outdoor field trip for students. You have received an email from a parent asking for details about the excursion. Write a formal email responding to the parent:

- Explain the main educational and fun activities planned during the field trip
- Clarify why parents need to prepare a packed lunch for their children to bring along
- List any essential items or clothes children should bring for the trip

body.answer: First of all, I would like to inform you that the students will visit the city science museum in the morning and join team-building games in the botanical park in the afternoon.
body.example: For instance, students will watch a short 3D space show at 9:00 AM and work in small groups to plant green trees after lunch.
body.frame: I. [Formal] Reply to Inquiry (First of all) + D. Provide Information
body.reason: These activities provide knowledge and experience in science while helping children adjust and adapt to the social environment and build a strong sense of belonging.
body.requirement: Explain the main educational and fun activities planned during the field trip

body.answer: Regarding lunch, please be advised that parents need to prepare a packed lunch for their children because the outdoor park does not have a school canteen.
body.example: A simple lunchbox with rice, grilled chicken, fresh fruit, and a bottle of water will give your child enough energy for the afternoon games.
body.frame: I. [Formal] Reply to Inquiry (Regarding) + F. Provide Explanation
body.reason: The main reason for this is that bringing clean homemade food plays an essential role in protecting students' health and fits comfortably within each child's eating habits.
body.requirement: Clarify why parents need to prepare a packed lunch for their children to bring along

body.answer: As to your next concern, I believe you should pack comfortable sports clothes, a sun hat, walking shoes, and a small notebook for your child.
body.example: Please also put a light raincoat and a bottle of drinking water in their backpack in case the afternoon weather changes.
body.frame: I. [Formal] Reply to Inquiry (As to your next concern) + G. Provide Instruction / Suggestion
body.reason: This helps students stay on the safe side during outdoor activities and allows them to move comfortably without getting tired or sunburned.
